open_points.subject: reach_operation_element pre-send failure timestamps
open_points.text: Every time MUST come from kernel_now: an operation NodeExecutionDraft's started_at is the recorded_at of its EffectAttempt when it has one, otherwise the moment the check or send began, and ended_at the moment the outcome change is built.
open_points.other_text: A pre-send failure's NodeExecutionDraft has executed the ExecutedBinding of the binding, inputs the element's input PortRefs, no outputs, no resources_used, and started_at and ended_at the times of the check; it writes no EffectAttempt and leaves every approval of the element as it was.
open_points.question: Must ended_at be the time the check ended or the later time when the outcome change is built?

open_points.subject: send_under_authority JSON output disclosure class
open_points.text: otherwise each JSON output is published with put_value_bytes and becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the output port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items), its size and the class the binding declares for that port
open_points.other_text:
- Port fields (exact, no others exist): name: str, direction: PortDirection, value_schema: str, carriage: Carriage, media_type: str | None, cardinality: Cardinality, disclosure_class: DisclosureClass | None
- StoredValue fields (exact, no others exist): value_id: str, value_digest: str, carriage: Carriage, media_type: str | None, value_schema: str, disclosure_class: DisclosureClass, size_bytes: int
open_points.question: Must output ports require a non-null disclosure_class, or may send_under_authority substitute some non-null value when the class the binding declares is None?

open_points.text: a file output is published with spool_file under SpooledFileKey of the run, node, map_index, this attempt_number, the port and no list_index, becoming a SpooledFile of the port's declared class
